import collections
W=(33039,45039)
def closures(evs, lo, hi, delta=800):
    # adjacency of contact times (undirected)
    ev=[(u,v,t) for u,v,t in evs]
    # last-time index: for each pair, list of times
    pair=collections.defaultdict(list)
    adj=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for u,v,t in ev:
        a,b=min(u,v),max(u,v)
        pair[(a,b)].append(t)
        adj[u].append((t,v)); adj[v].append((t,u))
    res=[]
    for u,v,t in ev:
        if not (lo<=t<=hi): continue
        a,b=min(u,v),max(u,v)
        # find common neighbors c with both edges before t, and max(t1,t2) within delta
        Na={c:[] for c in []}
        na=collections.defaultdict(list); nb=collections.defaultdict(list)
        for tt,c in adj[u]:
            if tt<t: na[c].append(tt)
        for tt,c in adj[v]:
            if tt<t: nb[c].append(tt)
        for c in set(na)&set(nb):
            if c==u or c==v: continue
            t1=max(na[c]); t2=max(nb[c])
            supp=max(t1,t2)
            if t-supp<=delta:
                res.append((u,v,t,c,supp))
    return res

import collections, statistics, random
# null model: shuffle timestamps among events (preserve structure), count closures in window
def count_cl(evs, lo, hi, delta=800):
    adj=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for u,v,t in evs:
        adj[u].append((t,v)); adj[v].append((t,u))
    n=0
    for u,v,t in evs:
        if not (lo<=t<=hi): continue
        na={};nb={}
        for tt,c in adj[u]:
            if tt<t and (c not in na or tt>na[c]): na[c]=tt
        for tt,c in adj[v]:
            if tt<t and (c not in nb or tt>nb[c]): nb[c]=tt
        for c in set(na)&set(nb):
            if c==u or c==v: continue
            if t-max(na[c],nb[c])<=delta: n+=1
    return n
